propositions: make amend-msg silently drops Signed-off-by trailers from HEAD when the amended message file omits them, despite the tool being designed to prevent exactly this silent loss for Change-Id
compose_message() reads and re-attaches only Change-Id from HEAD; git commit --amend --file replaces the entire message, so any Signed-off-by present on HEAD but absent from the input file is lost

The tool's docstring and rationale acknowledge the presence of Signed-off-by in the trailer block, yet the implementation preserves only Change-Id, making one mandatory trailer loss unreachable while leaving the other reachable through the wrapper itself
When a message file supplies its own Signed-off-by, it must be respected and not duplicated; when it omits Signed-off-by, HEAD's existing sign-offs must be carried forward in order
Multiple distinct Signed-off-by trailers on HEAD must all survive the amend operation
Change-Id carry-forward semantics and existing refusal behavior when HEAD has no Change-Id must remain unchanged
